entities.name: Juuso Pärssinen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juuso Pärssinen is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the New York Rangers of the National Hockey League (NHL). Pärssinen was selected by the Nashville Predators in the seventh round, 210th overall, in the 2019 NHL entry draft, and has also played for the Colorado Avalanche.
